items.headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress named interim chief
items.summary: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation after 33 years leading the company, naming CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent successor. The abrupt leadership change at the world's most valuable chipmaker has rattled investors already nervous about AI-sector valuations.

items.headline: Anthropic makes record-breaking Nasdaq debut
items.summary: Anthropic began trading on Nasdaq under ticker ANT after pricing its IPO at $83 a share and raising roughly $81 billion at about a $1.5 trillion valuation, the largest IPO in history. The listing is a major test of investor appetite for frontier AI-lab valuations amid growing bubble concerns.

items.headline: Asian markets tumble as AI bubble fears mount
items.summary: Stock markets across Asia fell sharply, with the Nasdaq Composite erasing its 2026 gains, as investors grew more skeptical about the sustainability of massive AI infrastructure spending. The selloff underscores widening doubts on Wall Street about whether AI capital expenditure can be justified by returns.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.summary: OpenAI launched two new models: Astra, priced 20% cheaper than its predecessor and aimed at demanding professional work, and Sol, targeting everyday use. Astra is the first model OpenAI has deployed externally that meets the 'High' threshold for AI self-improvement under its Preparedness Framework, drawing added safety scrutiny.

items.headline: Four nonprofits sue OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and SpaceX to halt frontier AI development
items.summary: A coalition including Public Citizen and the Alliance for Secure AI filed suit in San Francisco Superior Court seeking an injunction to freeze advanced AI research at five major companies, relying on California's unfair competition law in an untested legal theory.

items.headline: Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU and Nemotron for Science at Supercomputing '26
items.summary: At the SC26 conference, Nvidia introduced its Rubin HPC GPU for scientific simulation and analytics, part of the Vera Rubin platform, alongside Nemotron for Science, an open model package paired with a chemistry dataset for building research agents. The push signals Nvidia's expansion from AI training workloads into traditional high-performance scientific computing.

items.headline: Nvidia expands chip supply chain deals with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics
items.summary: Nvidia announced new long-term agreements to add substrate capacity and expand production at existing factories, part of its push to secure components for sustained AI data-center chip growth amid continued demand for its GPUs.

items.headline: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2.5
items.summary: DeepMind's newest vision-language-action model reports 30-100% higher task success rates and 20-30% faster completion than its predecessor across more than 200 evaluated tasks, alongside an open-sourced ASIMOV-Jailbreak safety benchmark. It is rolling out first to DeepMind's robotics hardware partners rather than via public API.

items.headline: Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid hits 96% success rate in Mercedes-Benz factory pilot
items.summary: Running on Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics ER for task planning, Apptronik's Apollo 2 humanoid achieved a 96% success rate in an automotive parts-kitting trial at a Mercedes-Benz plant, among the strongest reported results yet for humanoid robots in real manufacturing settings.

items.headline: Alibaba opens limited preview of Qwen4-Max
items.summary: Alibaba unveiled Qwen4-Max-Preview, a flagship model with a 1-million-token context window built for coding, frontend design and multistep agent workflows, available only through a time-limited subscription that closes November 25. Alibaba claims 2.4 trillion total parameters, though independent benchmarking remains limited.

items.headline: Microsoft pushes agentic AI governance and security tools at Ignite 2026
items.summary: At its Ignite conference opening keynote, Microsoft framed Copilot as 'the new operating system for work' and announced Copilot Workspaces for human-agent collaboration, along with Entra Agent ID, Dynamic Agent Risk monitoring, and a broader push to give enterprise AI agents their own identities and oversight.
